# HingeConstraint2D

- Inherits [`Constraint2D`](constraint2d.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("HingeConstraint2D")`

A point both parts turn about: a door, a wheel, a pendulum, a lever. With `Anchor0` and `Anchor1` at the same place in the world, the parts stay together there and turn freely, limited or driven as below.

**Members below are the ones this class DECLARES.** Everything its base
offers is on the base's page, which is what keeps one added member on
`Instance` from being a change to every page here.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `LimitsEnabled` | `boolean` | `false` | read/write | Whether `LowerAngle` and `UpperAngle` apply. Off turns freely. |
| `LowerAngle` | `number` | `-90` | read/write | How far `Part1` may turn clockwise, in degrees, from how the two stood when the joint was made. |
| `MotorEnabled` | `boolean` | `false` | read/write | Whether the hinge drives itself towards `MotorSpeed`: a wheel, a fan, a windmill. |
| `MotorMaxTorque` | `number` | `0` | read/write | The most torque the motor applies, in newton metres. What stops it is anything that needs more. |
| `MotorSpeed` | `number` | `0` | read/write | The speed the motor drives to, in degrees per second, counter-clockwise positive. |
| `UpperAngle` | `number` | `90` | read/write | How far it may turn counter-clockwise, the same way. |
